page.layout: One column of names, ruled into groups by year, with the years in the left margin; the running head sits above the column. The column is cut off at the foot of this part.; One narrow column of italic summary text at the right of the page, below the printed page number 305. No running head, catchword or signature.

l.i: [ Hi quatuor usque ad XII. Iulij, tum his substituti alij quatuor. ]

p.i: Castella Emotil-lanum, Reidanū, Solt camp. ab Ordinibus fœderatis duce Guil-helmo Comite Nas-sovio Hispanicis ad-dempta.
Emotillā Hispanici recuperant. Ager omnis in ora a milite Ordinū affligitur.
Groninga ab Ordinibus confœderatis, ducibus Nassavis obsidione nequicquā tentata: Delfsila, Upslachtum, Emo-tilla, captæ.
Castellum apud Bellingwoldios excitatum. Groninga ab Hispanicis res men-dacis [?] sustentata.
Groninga obsessa dedita, & Ordinum general. societati reddita. Ei & agro gubernator datus illustris Comes GUIL. LUD. NASS.

page.notes: The year figures in the left margin are marginal notes, each set beside its group. The bracketed italic line is printed within the list. The name "Vbbena" in the first group and "Ybbena" in the 1593 group are as far as I can read them; the first letter may be Y in both. "Vlger" and "Vpkena" are copied with the printed V. Reading of "men-dacis" at the line end is doubtful; the printed hyphenated form is hard to make out. "Nassavijs" and "Nassovijs" were normalised to i/j rules as vowel i. "Upslachtum" and "GUIL. LUD." were normalised from V to U per the vowel rule.
